readme:
# Crunchbase Scraper

Unlock the world's most comprehensive startup and private company database. Extract funding rounds, investor networks, team sizes, categories, and contact details from Crunchbase company profiles — the same data trusted by VCs, M&A analysts, and B2B sales teams.

Whether you're sourcing deal flow, researching competitors, or building a prospect list of well-funded startups, this scraper turns Crunchbase into a structured data feed you can pipe straight into your CRM, BI tool, or data warehouse.

## Features

- **Rich company profiles** — name, description, website, logo, social links
- **Full funding history** — total raised, round count, last round type/date/amount, IPO status
- **Investor intelligence** — named investors and backers per company
- **Firmographics** — employee count ranges, revenue estimates, founding date
- **Location data** — city, country, full address, country codes
- **Categories & industries** — standardized industry tags
- **Contact details** — email and phone when publicly listed
- **Two input modes** — direct organization URLs or keyword + location search
- **Clean output** — ready-to-use JSON with consistent field naming

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/crunchbase-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `crunchbase-scraper` to scrape company data from crunchbase. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Input Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `urls` | array | Direct Crunchbase organization URLs (e.g. `https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/openai`) |
| `searchQuery` | string | Keyword search (e.g. `artificial intelligence`, `fintech`, `healthtech`). Used when no URLs are provided |
| `location` | string | Filter search results by location (e.g. `San Francisco`, `Germany`, `Europe`) |
| `maxResults` | integer | Maximum number of companies to return (default 100, max 1000) |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | Proxy settings — **residential proxy required** to bypass anti-bot protection |

### Example Input — Direct URLs

```json
{
  "urls": [
    "https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/openai",
    "https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/stripe",
    "https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/anthropic"
  ]
}
```

### Example Input — Search

```json
{
  "searchQuery": "artificial intelligence",
  "location": "San Francisco",
  "maxResults": 50,
  "proxyConfiguration": {
    "useApifyProxy": true,
    "apifyProxyGroups": ["RESIDENTIAL"]
  }
}
```

## Use Cases

- **B2B Sales Intelligence** — build prospect lists of recently funded companies in your ICP, enrich CRM records with funding data and employee counts
- **Investment Research** — track deal flow, monitor portfolio companies, identify co-investors and investment trends across sectors and geographies
- **Competitor Tracking** — monitor competitor funding rounds, team growth, and strategic investors in real time
- **Deal Sourcing** — discover emerging startups in specific verticals before they hit mainstream coverage
- **M&A Research** — build target lists filtered by funding stage, revenue range, employee count, and geography
- **Market Intelligence** — map industry landscapes, identify market leaders, analyze funding distribution by category

## Pricing

Pay-per-result pricing — you only pay for what you extract.

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|

| Search result (SERP) | $0.003 |

A typical run scraping 100 companies via search costs roughly **$1.10** — far less than manual research or Crunchbase Pro subscription tiers.
